summary: Come to think about it @Snorremd I already use domains on my @Glitch sites to login. I sorta use the platform as my learning/staging server. Most of my sites set up so I can use my Glitch project page url to log into sites that support logging in using IndieAuth
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Come to think about it @Snorremd I already use domains on my @Glitch sites to login. I sorta use the platform as my learning/staging server. Most of my sites set up so I can use my Glitch project page url to log into sites that support logging in using IndieAuth
